verdict.rationale: Sentry provides an official MCP server enabling natural-language interactions with AI assistants (searching errors, triaging issues, managing projects) and a one-command setup for agents like Claude Code/Cursor/Codex, indicating agentic/natural-language operability. However, this is scoped to querying/managing Sentry data via connected agents rather than a native NL command interface within Sentry itself, and MCP access is gated behind paid plans. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of NL command reliability, evidence of broad natural-language coverage beyond MCP-supported actions, and confirmation this works outside paid tiers.
